_comment: List-level metadata, keyed by the slugified name of the source list (the Takeout CSV filename). This file wins over anything in the generated JSON, so renaming or hiding a list survives every re-import. Per-place blurbs still live in src/data/lists/*.json and are merged separately.

favorites.name: The short list
favorites.blurb: The ones that get recommended without hesitating first.

starred-places.name: Starred and never sorted
starred-places.blurb: Years of one-tap saves that never got filed anywhere. Unfiltered, occasionally random, occasionally the best thing here.

bellevue.blurb: Everything saved across the lake, still in one pile. Being broken up by category later.
